title: Find and Export Browser History to CSV, JSON or HTML | HistoryOut
description:
Find a page again. Keep the history you need. HistoryOut is a free browser history extension that searches and filters available history, then exports matching visits as CSV, JSON or readable HTML.

Install HistoryOut:
https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/historyout-export-chrome/idohnkdgejocejlkihihonhemndpiiei

Features, browser options and examples:
https://historyout.sauliusdev.chatgpt.site/

This demo shows the upcoming update. Check the changelog for release status:
https://historyout.sauliusdev.chatgpt.site/changelog/

00:00 Find your pages again
00:12 Save a view and choose your export
00:24 Keep a useful history file

What can I export?
CSV for Excel or Google Sheets, JSON for structured data, or HTML for a readable local file with clickable links.

Does HistoryOut upload my history?
No. It reads available browser history when you choose Preview or export. Files download to your device. No account or subscription is required.

Can it recover deleted history?
No. It works with history available to your current browser profile. Saved views remember settings; they do not create a permanent history archive.

Which browsers can install it?
Chrome and Brave use the Chrome Web Store. Edge also supports other-store installations and has its own Add-ons store. See the website for current verification and installation details.

Useful to you? An optional contribution supports my independent development. Every HistoryOut feature stays free:
https://www.buymeacoffee.com/saulius.developer
